root_causes: Daily blog publisher SEO fallback selected first two title words despite the first being a question starter. This converted a legitimate Dutch title into 'Hoe Nederlandse: wat verandert er voor jou?'.
The existing daily publication PR lacked the mandatory Brain learning, activity-ledger and human change artifact, so protected CI correctly refused the merge.
prevention: Derive SEO focus from the first substantive subject phrase instead of question starters; avoid single generic question/article/preposition focus.
Attach material writeback closure to the SAME daily blog publication PR; keep exact canonical URL, CI, translation cache, protected merge and Netlify public readback; never duplicate the day.
Never mistake created PR / generated HTML for publicly verified publication or accept invented translation evidence.
